answer: A falcon-eyed watcher plants decoy trade offers each epoch, bait only an operator steering many wallets would rationally sweep. An honest agent perched on its own niche ledge ignores deals outside its lane, but a sybil farm hunting every scrap across the whole reef of accounts snaps at the same decoys from correlated keys. The ledger clusters who bit which bait, folds the swarm into one voice, and burns its padded stake, so flooding with clones trips the trap instead of multiplying influence.
